title: backlog.md says every CI job is manual, but kb-tests-windows starts on its own for tool changes
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md's red-pipeline paragraph no longer says every job in .gitlab-ci.yml is manual: it names kb-tests-windows as the job that starts on its own for tool changes (with allow_failure: true), so the reason given for reading the pipeline by its jobs stays true

run: import pathlib,sys; sys.exit(1 if 'every job in `.gitlab-ci.yml` is manual' in pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8') else 0)
